title: PP_NOC_E2E truthiness check: any non-empty value (e.g. PP_NOC_E2E=0) arms the scripted key-injection/auto-exit drive
detail: Compared against "" rather than "1", so PP_NOC_E2E=0 or =false still activates the e2e drive: scripted D presses, two bin/noc-e2e-*.png captures, self-exit at frame 300. PP_DEBUG dev builds only; release compiles it out. Low impact, but env is a trust boundary and strict parsing avoids surprise self-driving runs.
recommended_fix: Parse strictly, e.g. `os.get_env_alloc("PP_NOC_E2E", context.allocator) == "1"` (matches run-dev.sh's `PP_NOC_E2E=1` setter); free the env string with context.temp_allocator like settings.odin does.
